title: Transport of the exchange equation to arbitrary K-injective representatives
statement:
Let (g':X'→X, f':X'→Y', f:X→Y, g:Y'→Y) be a cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. All sheaves are abelian sheaves on the small étale sites. Write F=f_*, F'=f'_*, G=g^{-1}, G'=g'^{-1} for the additive sheaf functors [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Write q_T for the quotient of ℤ-indexed cochain complexes on T to their homotopy category and Qh for its derived localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let ι_T:D⁺(T_et)→D(T_et) be the inclusion, R⁺F and R⁺F' the bounded below right derived functors, and let φ^G_M:G(Qh M)≅Qh(G M) and φ^{G'}_M denote the exact inverse-image comparison isomorphisms [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image].

Fix K∈D⁺(X_et) and put K'=G'K. Let E:K⁺(Inj(X_et))≌D⁺(X_et) and E':K⁺(Inj(X'_et))≌D⁺(X'_et) be the standard injective-object equivalences. Put P=ι_Inj(E^{-1}K), P'=ι_Inj(E'^{-1}K'), regarded as bounded below homotopy objects, and ρ=ι_X(E.counit_K^{-1}):ι_XK→Qh P, ρ'=ι_X'(E'.counit_K'^{-1}):ι_X'K'→Qh P'.

Let I be a K-injective cochain complex on X_et [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions], s:ι_XK≅Qh(q_X I) an isomorphism, J a K-injective cochain complex on X'_et, and j:G'I→J a quasi-isomorphism. Define t=G'(s.hom)≫(φ^{G'}_{q_X I}).hom≫Qh(q_X'(j)). Define ex₀:I under (F⋙G)→I under (G'⋙F') by applying the underived exchange [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange] term by term, and set e=ex₀≫F'(j). For arbitrary homotopy classes h₁:q_X I→P and h₂:q_X' J→P' satisfying s.hom≫Qh(h₁)=ρ and t≫Qh(h₂)=ρ', define
χ=Qh(F(h₁))≫ι_Y(Unit_{R⁺F,P}≫R⁺F(E.counit_K)),
χ'=Qh(F'(h₂))≫ι_Y'(Unit_{R⁺F',P'}≫R⁺F'(E'.counit_K')),
σsrc=(φ^G_{F(q_X I)})^{-1}≫G(χ).
Let Ex_K be the bounded below derived exchange [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]. The comparison equation referred to below is
σsrc≫ι_Y'(Ex_K)=Qh(q_Y'(e))≫χ'.

Assume that for this fixed square, K and J, the comparison equation holds for every bounded below K-injective source I₀, every representation isomorphism s₀:ι_XK≅Qh(q_X I₀), every quasi-isomorphism j₀:G'I₀→J, every integer lower bound n on I₀, and every compatible pair of comparison classes (with the same definitions after replacing I,s,j by I₀,s₀,j₀). Then the comparison equation also holds for the arbitrary, possibly unbounded I,s,j specified above and every compatible pair (h₁,h₂). This is the extension from bounded below representatives to arbitrary K-injective representatives.

proof.text: Assume the bounded formula. (Part (b) in general: reduction to a bounded below resolution.) Let $P=I(K)$ (bounded below, K-injective), $h:I\to P$ the homotopy equivalence of step 1 with $Q(h)s=\rho_K$, $h'$ a homotopy inverse. The termwise functors $g'^{-1}$, $g^{-1}$, $f_*$, $f'_*$ preserve homotopies ([lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy] (b)), so $j_P:=j\circ g'^{-1}(h'):g'^{-1}P\to J$ is a quasi-isomorphism, a K-injective resolution, and step 6 applies to $(P,\rho_K,j_P)$. Compare the data: (1) by naturality of $\Ex^0_\square$ [lemma-weil-pbc-underived-exchange-naturality], $e_P\circ g^{-1}f_*(h)=f'_*(j)f'_*g'^{-1}(h'h)\Ex^0_{\square,I}\simeq e$; (2) $\chi_{(P,\rho_K)}=\mathrm{id}$, and by naturality of $\varphi^g$, $\sigma_{\rm src}(I)=g^{-1}Q(f_*h)(\varphi^g_{f_*I})^{-1}=(\varphi^g_{f_*P})^{-1}Q(g^{-1}f_*h)=\sigma_{\rm src}(P)\circ Q(g^{-1}f_*h)$; (3) by naturality of $\varphi^{g'}$, $t_P=Q(j)Q(g'^{-1}h')\varphi^{g'}_Pg'^{-1}(Q(h)s)=Q(j)Q(g'^{-1}(h'h))\varphi^{g'}_Ig'^{-1}(s)=t$, so $\sigma_{\rm tgt}$ is the same. Hence $\Ex_{\square,K}\sigma_{\rm src}(I)=\Ex_{\square,K}\sigma_{\rm src}(P)Q(g^{-1}f_*h)=\sigma_{\rm tgt}Q(e_P)Q(g^{-1}f_*h)=\sigma_{\rm tgt}Q(e)$.

lemma derivedExchangeUnboundedTransport
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective]
    (s : DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K ≅
      DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj I))
    (J : CochainComplex (Sheaf X'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    [J.IsKInjective]
    (j : (((g')^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I ⟶ J)
    [QuasiIso j]
    (bounded : ∀
    (I₀ : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    [I₀.IsKInjective]
    (s₀ : DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K ≅
      DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj I₀))
    (j₀ : (((g')^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I₀ ⟶ J)
    [QuasiIso j₀]
    (n : ℤ) [I₀.IsStrictlyGE n],
    let B := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let C := Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B
    let C' := Sheaf X'.smallEtaleTopology B
    let q := HomotopyCategory.quotient C (.up ℤ)
    let q' := HomotopyCategory.quotient C' (.up ℤ)
    let qY := HomotopyCategory.quotient (Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology B) (.up ℤ)
    let F := (f)_*[B]
    let F' := (f')_*[B]
    let G := (g)^*[B]
    let G' := (g')^*[B]
    let E := DerivedCategory.Plus.injectiveObjectEquivalence C
    let E' := DerivedCategory.Plus.injectiveObjectEquivalence C'
    let K' := G'.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K
    let P := (InjectiveObject.ι C).mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj (E.inverse.obj K)
    let P' := (InjectiveObject.ι C').mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj (E'.inverse.obj K')
    let ρ := DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (E.counitIso.inv.app K)
    let ρ' := DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (E'.counitIso.inv.app K')
    let t := G'.mapDerivedCategory.map s₀.hom ≫
      G'.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app (q.obj I₀) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map (q'.map j₀)
    let ex₀ := (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
      (Etale.baseChangeMap B sq.toCommSq) (.up ℤ)).app I₀
    let e := ex₀ ≫ (F'.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map j₀
    ∀ h : ((q.obj I₀ ⟶ P.obj) × (q'.obj J ⟶ P'.obj)),
      s₀.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map h.1 = ρ →
      t ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map h.2 = ρ' →
      let χ := DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map h.1) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (F.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app P ≫
          F.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map (E.counitIso.hom.app K))
      let χ' := DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((F'.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map h.2) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (F'.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app P' ≫
          F'.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map (E'.counitIso.hom.app K'))
      let σsrc := G.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app
        ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj (q.obj I₀)) ≫ G.mapDerivedCategory.map χ
      σsrc ≫ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map
          ((Etale.derivedBaseChangeMapPlus B sq.toCommSq).app K) =
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map (qY.map e) ≫ χ' ) :
    let B := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let C := Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B
    let C' := Sheaf X'.smallEtaleTopology B
    let q := HomotopyCategory.quotient C (.up ℤ)
    let q' := HomotopyCategory.quotient C' (.up ℤ)
    let qY := HomotopyCategory.quotient (Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology B) (.up ℤ)
    let F := (f)_*[B]
    let F' := (f')_*[B]
    let G := (g)^*[B]
    let G' := (g')^*[B]
    let E := DerivedCategory.Plus.injectiveObjectEquivalence C
    let E' := DerivedCategory.Plus.injectiveObjectEquivalence C'
    let K' := G'.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K
    let P := (InjectiveObject.ι C).mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj (E.inverse.obj K)
    let P' := (InjectiveObject.ι C').mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj (E'.inverse.obj K')
    let ρ := DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (E.counitIso.inv.app K)
    let ρ' := DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (E'.counitIso.inv.app K')
    let t := G'.mapDerivedCategory.map s.hom ≫
      G'.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app (q.obj I) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map (q'.map j)
    let ex₀ := (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
      (Etale.baseChangeMap B sq.toCommSq) (.up ℤ)).app I
    let e := ex₀ ≫ (F'.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map j
    ∀ h : ((q.obj I ⟶ P.obj) × (q'.obj J ⟶ P'.obj)),
      s.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map h.1 = ρ →
      t ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map h.2 = ρ' →
      let χ := DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map h.1) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (F.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app P ≫
          F.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map (E.counitIso.hom.app K))
      let χ' := DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((F'.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map h.2) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (F'.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app P' ≫
          F'.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map (E'.counitIso.hom.app K'))
      let σsrc := G.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app
        ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj (q.obj I)) ≫ G.mapDerivedCategory.map χ
      σsrc ≫ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map
          ((Etale.derivedBaseChangeMapPlus B sq.toCommSq).app K) =
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map (qY.map e) ≫ χ'
